chapter: Childhood in Tyler, Beaumont and Houston
title: Practising at home; his mother buys him a snare drum
summary: He had been practising at home on a small drum his mother had bought; seeing he was serious she then bought a snare drum.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: And so, I sat there playing, but he didn't know that I'd been practicing.
But you didn't have real drums.
Oh, I had a little -- I had a drum that my mother bought me.
Well, she bought that little drum for me, I would say, about ten or 11 years old.
By this time you'd marched in the band and she was --
Oh, I marched in the band in Houston. I mean, in Beaumont, Texas.
And so, when she saw that, she realized you were serious.
Then she bought me a snare drum, see.
